protocol.training: At each00:00ET use latest120prior dates with source paired calibration ready and BOTH complete14day labels released strictly before cutoff;minimum60. Use one observed contract return per date for the currently selected ETF. Pool membership independent of actual historical buy/action or outcome sign. protocol.conditioning: score=as-issued calibrated candidate logvalue;advantage=direction*as-issued calibratedD;relative5,breadth5,volume_direction_diffusion from v14 multiplied by ETF direction;logsectorvol unsigned. For candidate symbol query same-symbol historical rows,including dates when it was not top. Standardize with recency-weighted mean/std of only eligible120rows;std<1e-12->1. No month/year feature.
protocol.distribution: Squared distance=mean squared standardized difference over6columns. Bandwidth squared=max(40th-smallest distance,1e-12). Kernel=exp(-distance/(2*bandwidth_squared));multiply recency,normalize to1. All rows retained,not hard nearest40 truncation. Require effective dates1/sum(w^2)>=20. Use empirical actual net returns,not shifted residuals that could invent payoffs above the TP. Weighted lower5%tail includes fractional quantile mass;diagnostic only,not a guaranteed bound.
protocol.utility: At fixed fractions[0,.25,.5,.75,1],scenario terminal wealth=1+f*historical_net_return. Primary gamma5 score=sum(w*((wealth^(1-gamma)-1)/(1-gamma))). Choose largest score;within1e-12ties take lower fraction,zero meanscash. Gamma1 logwealth control. This is one-contract empirical CRRA utility,not an analytical Merton optimum or a proven monthly-risk guarantee. No leverage,no risk-parameter search.
